The '''1991 New Zealand National Soccer League''' was the 22nd season of a nationwide [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin]] club competition in [[New Zealand]] football.

==Promotion and relegation==
[[Waterside Karori]] was [[Promotion and relegation|relegated]] at the end of the 1990 season, to be replaced by the winner of a play-off series between teams from the northern, central, and southern leagues ([[Mount Albert-Ponsonby]], [[Nelson United]], and [[Burndale United]] respectively). Nelson United won the series to gain [[Promotion and relegation|promotion]], but there is some controversy about their participation in the play-offs as they had only finished second in the central regional league, which was won by [[Petone FC|Petone]].<ref name="rsssf90">{{cite web | url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/nz90.html | title=New Zealand 1990 | website=[[RSSSF]] | accessdate=11 April 2019 }}</ref>

[[Gisborne City]] were relegated at the end of the 1991 season.
